Subject: Outstanding balance INV-2026-11-4387 — proposal for staggered tranche + VAT evidence

Elena —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, Lumos has an outstanding balance of EUR 112,450 on invoice INV-2026-11-4387 (due 2026-11-30). We want to get ahead of the escalation and propose a pragmatic path that protects your access while reducing credit risk for both sides.

Proposed approach (simple, actionable):
- Tranche 1: EUR 56,225 (50%) by 22 Dec 2026 — covers immediate service continuity.
- Tranche 2: EUR 28,112.50 (25%) by 31 Jan 2027.
- Tranche 3: remaining EUR 28,112.50 by 28 Feb 2027.

We also need formal VAT evidence to validate cross-border treatment — either a completed VAT reverse-charge declaration or the vendor remit with VAT registration numbers. Can you confirm which file you will upload? If helpful, we can accept a provisional remittance advice to unblock the first tranche and collect the VAT evidence before tranche 2.

If this schedule works I’ll raise a short canary SLA and freeze any further collections escalation while milestones are met. If not, tell us what is realistic and we’ll work it into our collections plan.

Attachments: INV-2026-11-4387.pdf (invoice)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
